# `code.log.list`

List commits under a revision

Ancestors of the resolved commit, optionally narrowed to one path. An empty rev reads the default branch.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/log/{rev...}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code log list`
- MCP: `code_log_list`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | no | `string` |
| `first_parent` | query | no | `boolean` |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `path` | query | no | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `rev` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
